definitions.explanation: A person with specialized technical knowledge and skills, working in fields such as engineering, IT, manufacturing, or applied sciences.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{自動車|じどうしゃ}メーカーの{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}だ。
examples.english: My father is an engineer at an automobile company.

examples.japanese: {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}を{確保|かくほ}するのが{難|むずか}しくなっている。
examples.english: It is becoming difficult to secure talented engineers.

examples.japanese: この{橋|はし}は{日本|にほん}の{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}たちが{設計|せっけい}し、{世界|せかい}でも{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: This bridge was designed by Japanese engineers and has attracted attention worldwide.

notes:
USAGE:
A broad term covering various types of technical professionals. Can refer to software engineers, mechanical engineers, civil engineers, and other specialists. In immigration contexts, {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ} is one of the visa categories for foreign workers in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- IT{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ} (IT engineer)
- {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}を{育成|いくせい}する (to train engineers)
- {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}{不足|ぶそく} (shortage of engineers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- エンジニア: engineer — loanword, often used in IT and software contexts
- {研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}: researcher — focuses on research rather than applied work
